title: TextSeal2: Distortion-Free LLM Watermarking with Copula Mixing and Memoryless Races
abstract: arXiv:2610.40613v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We present TextSeal2, a distortion-free watermark for large language models that keeps its signal under speculative decoding: tokens that replace rejected drafts remain watermarked with the same keys, and the acceptance rate is unchanged. It also preserves output diversity and adds no measurable inference latency. Its predecessor, TextSeal, restores diversity in the Gumbel-max scheme by routing each token to one of two keys via a coin flip. This is suboptimal because the detector averages the scores from both keys without knowing which key was used. TextSeal2 instead merges two or more keys into a single virtual key and couples it to fresh noise through AutoMark's Gaussian copula. Any number of keys, including publicly shared keys, can be merged this way without diluting detection. Under speculative decoding, TextSeal2 verifies keyed drafts with one more exponential race, run on the leftovers of the draft races. By memorylessness, this

translated_title: TextSeal2：基于Copula混合与无记忆竞赛的无失真大语言模型水印
translated_abstract: 我们提出了TextSeal2，这是一种面向大语言模型的无失真水印方法，能够在投机解码下保持其检测信号：替换被拒绝草稿的令牌仍使用相同的密钥携带水印，且接受率保持不变。它还能保持输出多样性，且不增加可测量的推理延迟。其前身TextSeal通过抛硬币的方式将每个令牌分配到两个密钥之一，从而在Gumbel-max方案中恢复多样性。但这种方法并不最优，因为检测器在不知道使用了哪个密钥的情况下会对两个密钥的分数进行平均。TextSeal2则将两个或多个密钥合并为一个虚拟密钥，并通过AutoMark的高斯Copula将其与新鲜噪声耦合。任意数量的密钥（包括公开共享的密钥）都可以这种方式合并，而不会稀释检测能力。在投机解码下，TextSeal2通过在草稿竞赛的剩余部分上运行一次额外的指数竞赛来验证带密钥的草稿。凭借无记忆性，此……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: TextSeal2提出了一种在投机解码下依然有效的无失真大语言模型水印，通过高斯Copula将多个密钥合并为单个虚拟密钥以避免检测分数被稀释，并利用指数竞赛的无记忆性在保持水印信号的同时不影响输出多样性和推理延迟。
en_tdlr: TextSeal2 proposes a distortion-free LLM watermark that survives speculative decoding by merging multiple keys into a single virtual key via Gaussian copula mixing, and by leveraging the memorylessness of exponential races to preserve watermark detectability without sacrificing output diversity or inference speed.
